parsed.summary: Wacky Wheels Lexington is down from 2027-03-16 to 2027-03-18 due to a line software outage. The supply-chain control tower rescheduled 9 production orders at the same plant, notified 32 dealers once each for 79 customer orders, and assigned 18 loaners.
parsed.decision_reason: The control tower acted because it was a real incident of type plant_outage with confirmed identifiers and dates. It followed operational rules by resolving IDs against the data, passing the digital twin rehearsal with zero failures, and matching the live baseline before the first write.
